raw_concession_text: Your New Home Starts Here!! Luxury 1 Bedrooms Starting at Just $999! Move Now & Receive 1 Month FREE on Select Apartment Homes! ... *Offer valid on select apartment homes for a limited time. Restrictions apply.
labeling_notes: Read the homepage and floor plans (7 advertised plans), then counted every listed unit on all 7 availability pages: 22 1BR + 10 2BR + 2 3BR = 34, including future move-ins. Each unit shows a price range, which is lease-term pricing: spreads vary per unit and the low end always equals the plan card's 'Starting at' price, so the low end is taken as base rent. Cross-checked against the structured unit data in the page markup. Concession 4: a site-wide '1 Month FREE' modal, qualified 'on Select Apartment Homes' (unspecified subset). The banner's '$999' headline is a marketing round-down; the lowest listed 1BR is $1,000.
